subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should this grouped set of 14 executable action upgrades be approved once the current exact-head checks finish, or should the credentialed Codex and release-action updates be reviewed separately?
rationale: The patch is mechanically sound, but approving new executable revisions in secret-bearing and release workflows is a repository security-boundary decision that the protected label reserves for a human.

options.title: Approve after exact-head validation
options.body: Keep the grouped update and merge after the current head passes security, workflow-sanity, release-sensitive, and Codex-agent checks.

options.title: Split sensitive action families
options.body: Separate Codex, token, CodeQL, and Docker release action bumps into smaller PRs if targeted validation fails or maintainers want narrower rollback boundaries.

recommendation.title: Approve after exact-head validation
recommendation.body: Keep the grouped update and merge after the current head passes security, workflow-sanity, release-sensitive, and Codex-agent checks.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history connects this person to release workflow validation and the live PR timeline shows direct awareness of this update.
